title: Bad Trips Guide, Round 43
intro: Round 44 (2026-11-20). Your round-43 versions are in, whole: DMSO beside the charcoal water, and Dealing With Shadow Thoughts up to "So relax ..." ([every check of this turn](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h58-20261120/RESULTS.md)).

"Sensitivity varies" is back in DMSO's nausea line, with what to do about it: "Sensitivity to DMSO varies, so start with less than you planned." Niacin's liver line now puts the risk where you said it is: "Sustained-release niacin, or repeated doses through the day, can create a real risk of liver damage ...", with the trial that compared the two forms linked. Both read Human High by themselves.

The paragraph you left me after your rewrite ("you can try to fix p5") read AI as it stands and in both of my tries, so it is card 1. Your own four paragraphs that read below High by themselves didn't lift with a word or two of mine (two read worse), so they are cards 2 to 5: the words are yours.

suggestions.whose: he asked: Joel, 2026-11-20 00:01 UTC, on the paragraph after his rewrite of Dealing With Shadow Thoughts: "you can try to fix p5"
suggestions.title: 1. Dealing With Shadow Thoughts: what to do with the thought during a trip
suggestions.reading: By itself, as the guide has it: [AI, one window High over the whole paragraph](https://www.pangram.com/history/ee4961ce-4aee-4b77-b6ce-e01284c48936).
suggestions.tested:
The four don'ts unpacked, each with its reason from your paragraphs above it, the script and your room-first line as they are: [AI High in every window](https://www.pangram.com/history/1eac3d57-ac94-4ce3-95f0-fbe122bbadb2).

Then two fresh readers listed what reads machine-made ([the panel](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h58-20261120/panel-d02/PANEL.md)): they agreed on four of the five sentences, and on the whole (an even run of sentences of one length, no specific detail). So the next try showed what a shadow thought looks like on a trip (suddenly hating someone you love, being sure you're a fraud) and put the confession in the reader's own night (texting your whole family at 3 a.m.): [AI High again](https://www.pangram.com/history/aa4b1c55-60dd-454c-a017-07052bab050d).
suggestions.sense: Fresh readers each time: "identify with" can mean relate to or take as yourself; "hold off on confessing it to everybody" sounded to one like keeping it from the sitter, who is the one to tell; and "return to room, body, human, time, and love" lists the Grounding Menu's order without saying so ("time" is hard to come back to when time is warped, and "human" could be a person or being human). Each try kept room before body, your Q-5.
suggestions.why: Your section above it now reads Human High as a whole, and this is the one paragraph that tells someone what to do in the moment. Both my tries read AI, as my lists of don'ts in your frame have before. How you'd say it teaches me the other in-the-moment paragraphs of the shadow part (Demons, Abuse Memories, Spiritual).
suggestions.advice_note: Edit it: the paragraph in your words. Your version goes in whole.
